_meta.role: Machine Learning Engineer (Quantization Tooling, AISW Tools)

summary: Recent M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY. Hands-on experience in model quantization and inference optimization, using PyTorch, ONNX, and TensorRT to shrink and accelerate deep learning models, including an 8-bit quantization pipeline (LLM.int8) that cut GPU memory by ~55% with under 1% accuracy loss, and TensorRT-optimized YOLO inference at a 5.2x speedup. Background spans CUDA kernel engineering, transformer architectures built from scratch, and C++/Linux systems development.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Curated and annotated a custom toothbrush detection dataset for health-level classification using YOLOv8.
Trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 annotated images achieving 83% mAP@50 on held-out validation; exported to ONNX and TFLite for mobile deployment.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT (OCR-free visual document understanding transformer) in PyTorch using HuggingFace VisionEncoderDecoder API on a custom medical billing dataset; improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93%.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Trained U-Net segmentation with VGG-16, VGG-19, and ResNet-50 backbones on the BraTS 2020 multi-modal MRI dataset; evaluated on Dice Score and IoU, reporting accuracy-latency trade-offs for deployment.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a Python GUI using PyQt and Matplotlib for real-time data acquisition and experimental visualization; used GitLab for version control.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced GPU memory footprint by ~55% via 8-bit quantization (bitsandbytes LLM.int8()) on TinyLlama 1.1B; profiled peak VRAM and inference latency across prompt types using pynvml and psutil.
Benchmarked across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC; <1% accuracy degradation with +0.09 perplexity increase, near-lossless compression.
Evaluated trade-offs between model efficiency and task performance for edge deployment constraints.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Integrated faster-whisper STT and TensorRT-optimized YOLO for visual servoing (5.2x speedup: 56.7 to 10.9 ms, 17.6 to 92 FPS vs eager PyTorch) on a Jetson edge server.
Built a three-layer distributed pipeline (Flutter client, Flask-SocketIO server, Jetson+Arduino controller) over a unified WebSocket fabric.
Resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture); achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials).

projects.name: CUDA Kernel Optimization for VGG16 Inference
bullets: Replaced TorchScript conv layers in VGG16 with custom CUDA C++ kernels using memory coalescing and constant memory; coalesced kernel ran 49.2ms vs 73.3ms uncoalesced and 77.5ms CPU TorchScript (~35% speedup) with identical accuracy.
